描述_EN: the thin tapestry band is decorated with alternating fish and another unidentifiable animal in reserve, some details of which are suggested with red wool. The slightly rounded lower end of the band features a border leading to a drop-shaped pendant, adorned with a small red element standing out against a reserved background. fragment of polychrome tapestry strip added by stitching into a linen ground cloth. the other end is embellished with an oval shape in reserve appearing in a green rectangle.
描述_ZN: 薄薄的织锦带上交替装饰着鱼和另一种无法识别的动物的预留，其中一些细节是用红色羊毛建议的。 带子的下端，略带圆形，有一个边框，通向一个水滴状的吊坠，吊坠上有一个小的红色元素，在保留的背景下显得格外突出。 多色挂毯条的碎片，通过缝制到亚麻底布中添加。 另一端点缀着一个椭圆形的储备出现在一个绿色的矩形中。
时期: 埃及 拜占庭统治时期；伊斯兰统治时期
